page_title: MNU 4-2 SHU | Manchester Utd v Sheffield Utd 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Michael Salisbury has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester Utd.
90+9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Ethan Wheatley, who fails to shoot.
90+8' A cross by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90+7' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+6' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
90+5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+1' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) replacing Kobbie Mainoo.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ethan Wheatley (Manchester United) replaces Rasmus Hojlund.
90+1' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' The referee awards a corner and Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) goes over to take it.
90' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
89' Close! Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
88' Sheffield Utd are awarded a mid-range free kick.
88' The game is interrupted. Casemiro (Manchester United) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
87' James McAtee is substituted due to injury. Chris Wilder gives a chance to William Osula (Sheffield Utd).

85' 4 - 2 It's a goal! Bruno Fernandes plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 4:2.

81' 3 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Wesley Foderingham just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:2.
79' Casemiro (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wesley Foderingham, who smothers the ball.
78' Jayden Bogle comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd).
78' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
75' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
74' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
74' Ball possession – 75:25.
74' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
72' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
71' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
69' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
68' Sheffield Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
66' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
64' Today's match ends for Christian Eriksen who will be replaced by Scott McTominay (Manchester United).
63' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' Chris Wilder has decided to substitute Cameron Archer and he is replaced by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd).
61' 2 - 2 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Wesley Foderingham to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
61' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
61' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Manchester Utd.
60' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester Utd.
59' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
57' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
55' Substitution. Antony is replaced by Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
55' Antony (Manchester United) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A long-range free kick is awarded to Sheffield Utd.
52' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 8:3.

50' 1 - 2 Goal! Ben Osborn shows great vision to find Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 1:2.
49' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).
47' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
46' Half-time substitution. Chris Wilder decided to make a change. Andre Brooks is replaced by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd).
46' The whistle blows and Michael Salisbury starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared away by the defence.
45+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45+3' Rasmus Hojlund receives a sweet cross inside the box from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.

45+2' What a poor attempt! Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Wesley Foderingham leaps like a salmon to deny him.
44' Michael Salisbury sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
43' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the Manchester Utd goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

42' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Alejandro Garnacho sends a long raking pass onto the head of Harry Maguire (Manchester United), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
41' Manchester Utd have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
41' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle. Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Wesley Foderingham was alert and made a comfortable save.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
38' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
38' Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
37' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:1.
34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is caught offside!

31' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham pulls off a comfortable save.
31' The linesman signals that Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
29' 83:17 – the latest ball possession ratio.
26' Rasmus Hojlund has a look up and finds Antony (Manchester United) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
26' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
25' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but Wesley Foderingham punches the ball away.
25' Manchester Utd are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
23' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Wesley Foderingham.
21' That's a well-taken pass by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
21' Kobbie Mainoo received a sweet pass from Antony (Manchester United), but the advance is stopped.
20' The foul by Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) was seen by Michael Salisbury who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
19' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
17' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Wesley Foderingham.
17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
16' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
15' A wild effort from Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
12' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take a corner kick.
12' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.

11' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is flagged for offside.
9' A pass by Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
7' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' A pass from Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) is intercepted by Andre Onana and the move breaks down.
2' Casemiro (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
1' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Wesley Foderingham was alert and made a comfortable save.
1' The match has just started.
Manchester Utd will kick-off.
Michael Salisbury was nominated as the referee for this game.
